full_judgment: Ms. Nazmun Ara Sultana, J. :- This Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 14.07.2014 passed the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.5821 of 2000 discharging the Rule and thereby affirming the judgment and decree dated 21.09.2000 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Comilla in Title Appeal No.32 of 1994 dismissing the appeal and thereby affirming the judgment and decree dated 17.11.1993 passed by the learned Assistant Judge, Doudkandi, Comilla in Title Suit No.24 of 1991 dismissing the suit.
